summary: Typed requests between resources on the same side. One resource handles a message type, and others send to it or ask it and wait for a reply.

handle.summary: Handles a message type for this resource. The handler receives the payload and a reply function. Call reply(value) to answer a request.

request.summary: Sends a message to another resource on the same side (server to server, or one client script to another in the same game) and resolves to its reply. Rejects with `Resource is not available` while that resource has not started or registered any handler yet, and with `Resource does not handle this message type` when it has no handler for the type; list it in your package's `requires` so it starts first. Also rejects if the handler throws, or either resource stops. There is no built-in time limit, so a handler that never replies leaves it waiting.

params.name: The name of the other resource.

send.summary: Sends a message to another resource without waiting for a reply. Nothing happens if it has no handler for the type.

params.name: The name of the other resource.
